all_declarations.name: Resources.GroupSelectionRecurrence.pivotFraction
all_declarations.header: def pivotFraction (d : Nat) : ℝ

all_declarations.name: Resources.GroupSelectionRecurrence.sideFraction
all_declarations.header: def sideFraction (d : Nat) : ℝ

all_declarations.name: Resources.GroupSelectionRecurrence.fractions_pos
all_declarations.header:
theorem fractions_pos (d : Nat) (hd : 0 < d) :
    0 < pivotFraction d ∧ 0 < sideFraction d

all_declarations.name: Resources.GroupSelectionRecurrence.fraction_sum_eq
all_declarations.header:
theorem fraction_sum_eq (d : Nat) (hd : 0 < d) :
    pivotFraction d + sideFraction d =
      ((d : ℝ) + ((d / 2 : Nat) : ℝ) + 2) / (2 * (d : ℝ))

all_declarations.name: Resources.GroupSelectionRecurrence.contracts_iff_half_gap
all_declarations.header:
theorem contracts_iff_half_gap (d : Nat) (hd : 0 < d) :
    pivotFraction d + sideFraction d < 1 ↔ 2 < d - d / 2

all_declarations.name: Resources.GroupSelectionRecurrence.contracts_iff_five_le
all_declarations.header:
theorem contracts_iff_five_le (d : Nat) (hd : 0 < d) :
    pivotFraction d + sideFraction d < 1 ↔ 5 ≤ d

all_declarations.name: Resources.GroupSelectionRecurrence.odd_contracts_iff
all_declarations.header:
theorem odd_contracts_iff (r : Nat) :
    pivotFraction (2 * r + 1) + sideFraction (2 * r + 1) < 1 ↔ 2 ≤ r

all_declarations.name: Resources.GroupSelectionRecurrence.even_contracts_iff
all_declarations.header:
theorem even_contracts_iff (r : Nat) (hr : 0 < r) :
    pivotFraction (2 * r) + sideFraction (2 * r) < 1 ↔ 3 ≤ r

all_declarations.name: Resources.GroupSelectionRecurrence.pivotChild
all_declarations.header: def pivotChild (d n : Nat) : Nat

all_declarations.name: Resources.GroupSelectionRecurrence.sideChild
all_declarations.header: def sideChild (d n : Nat) : Nat

all_declarations.name: Resources.GroupSelectionRecurrence.pivotChild_one
all_declarations.header: theorem pivotChild_one (n : Nat) : pivotChild 1 n = n

all_declarations.name: Resources.GroupSelectionRecurrence.pivotChild_monotone
all_declarations.header: theorem pivotChild_monotone (d : Nat) : Monotone (pivotChild d)

all_declarations.name: Resources.GroupSelectionRecurrence.sideChild_monotone
all_declarations.header: theorem sideChild_monotone (d : Nat) : Monotone (sideChild d)

all_declarations.name: Resources.GroupSelectionRecurrence.two_group_bound_le_child
all_declarations.header:
theorem two_group_bound_le_child (d n s : Nat) (hd : 0 < d)
    (bound : s ≤ (d / 2) * pivotChild d n +
      (d - d / 2) * (pivotChild d n / 2)) : s ≤ sideChild d n

all_declarations.name: Resources.GroupSelectionRecurrence.cutoff
all_declarations.header: def cutoff (d : Nat) : Nat

all_declarations.name: Resources.GroupSelectionRecurrence.cutoff_threshold
all_declarations.header:
theorem cutoff_threshold (d : Nat) :
    (max 0 (0 : ℝ) + max 0 (d : ℝ) + 2) /
      (1 - pivotFraction d - sideFraction d) < (cutoff d : ℝ)

all_declarations.name: Resources.GroupSelectionRecurrence.children_lt
all_declarations.header:
theorem children_lt (d n : Nat) (hd : 5 ≤ d) (large : cutoff d < n) :
    pivotChild d n < n ∧ sideChild d n < n

all_declarations.name: Resources.GroupSelectionRecurrence.majorant
all_declarations.header: def majorant (d base slope constant : Nat) (hd : 5 ≤ d) (n : Nat) : Nat

all_declarations.name: Resources.GroupSelectionRecurrence.majorant_small
all_declarations.header:
theorem majorant_small (d base slope constant : Nat) (hd : 5 ≤ d)
    (n : Nat) (small : n ≤ cutoff d) : majorant d base slope constant hd n = base

all_declarations.name: Resources.GroupSelectionRecurrence.majorant_large
all_declarations.header:
theorem majorant_large (d base slope constant : Nat) (hd : 5 ≤ d)
    (n : Nat) (large : cutoff d < n) :
    majorant d base slope constant hd n =
      majorant d base slope constant hd (pivotChild d n) +
        majorant d base slope constant hd (sideChild d n) + slope * n + constant

all_declarations.name: Resources.GroupSelectionRecurrence.base_le_majorant
all_declarations.header:
theorem base_le_majorant (d base slope constant : Nat) (hd : 5 ≤ d) (n : Nat) :
    base ≤ majorant d base slope constant hd n

all_declarations.name: Resources.GroupSelectionRecurrence.majorant_monotone
all_declarations.header:
theorem majorant_monotone (d base slope constant : Nat) (hd : 5 ≤ d) :
    Monotone (majorant d base slope constant hd)

all_declarations.name: Resources.GroupSelectionRecurrence.majorant_affine_bound
all_declarations.header:
theorem majorant_affine_bound (d base slope constant : Nat) (hd : 5 ≤ d) :
    ∃ A B : Nat, ∀ n : Nat, majorant d base slope constant hd n ≤ A * n + B

all_declarations.name: Resources.GroupSelectionRecurrence.majorant_isBigO
all_declarations.header:
theorem majorant_isBigO (d base slope constant : Nat) (hd : 5 ≤ d) :
    Asymptotics.IsBigO Filter.atTop
      (fun n : Nat => (majorant d base slope constant hd n : ℝ)) (fun n => (n : ℝ))

all_declarations.name: Resources.GroupSelectionRecurrence.rounded_group_affine_bound
all_declarations.header:
theorem rounded_group_affine_bound (f : Nat → Nat) (d : Nat) (hd : 5 ≤ d)
    (leftOffset rightOffset : ℝ) (slope constant n0 : Nat)
    (recurrence : ∀ n, n0 < n →
      f n = f ⌈pivotFraction d * (n : ℝ) + leftOffset⌉₊ +
        f ⌈sideFraction d * (n : ℝ) + rightOffset⌉₊ + slope * n + constant) :
    ∃ A B : Nat, ∀ n : Nat, f n ≤ A * n + B

all_declarations.name: Examples.GroupSelectionRecurrence.zero_requires_positive_domain
all_declarations.header: theorem zero_requires_positive_domain : pivotFraction 0 + sideFraction 0 = 0

all_declarations.name: Examples.GroupSelectionRecurrence.singleton_group
all_declarations.header:
theorem singleton_group : pivotFraction 1 + sideFraction 1 = (3 : ℝ) / 2 ∧
    ∀ n : Nat, pivotChild 1 n = n

all_declarations.name: Examples.GroupSelectionRecurrence.group_two
all_declarations.header: theorem group_two : pivotFraction 2 + sideFraction 2 = (5 : ℝ) / 4

all_declarations.name: Examples.GroupSelectionRecurrence.groups_three_four
all_declarations.header:
theorem groups_three_four :
    pivotFraction 3 + sideFraction 3 = 1 ∧ pivotFraction 4 + sideFraction 4 = 1

all_declarations.name: Examples.GroupSelectionRecurrence.groups_five_six
all_declarations.header:
theorem groups_five_six :
    pivotFraction 5 + sideFraction 5 = (9 : ℝ) / 10 ∧
      pivotFraction 6 + sideFraction 6 = (11 : ℝ) / 12

all_declarations.name: Examples.GroupSelectionRecurrence.all_odd_even_thresholds
all_declarations.header:
theorem all_odd_even_thresholds (r : Nat) (hr : 0 < r) :
    (pivotFraction (2 * r + 1) + sideFraction (2 * r + 1) < 1 ↔ 2 ≤ r) ∧
      (pivotFraction (2 * r) + sideFraction (2 * r) < 1 ↔ 3 ≤ r)

all_declarations.name: Examples.GroupSelectionRecurrence.explicit_cutoffs
all_declarations.header:
theorem explicit_cutoffs : cutoff 5 = 71 ∧ cutoff 6 = 97 ∧
    cutoff 7 = 64 ∧ cutoff 8 = 81

all_declarations.name: Examples.GroupSelectionRecurrence.first_five_children
all_declarations.header: theorem first_five_children : pivotChild 5 72 = 15 ∧ sideChild 5 72 = 56

all_declarations.name: Examples.GroupSelectionRecurrence.first_six_children
all_declarations.header: theorem first_six_children : pivotChild 6 98 = 17 ∧ sideChild 6 98 = 80

all_declarations.name: Examples.GroupSelectionRecurrence.zero_base_value
all_declarations.header:
theorem zero_base_value (d base slope constant : Nat) (hd : 5 ≤ d) :
    majorant d base slope constant hd 0 = base

all_declarations.name: Examples.GroupSelectionRecurrence.last_five_base
all_declarations.header: theorem last_five_base : majorant 5 1 2 3 (by decide) 71 = 1

all_declarations.name: Examples.GroupSelectionRecurrence.first_five_recurrence
all_declarations.header: theorem first_five_recurrence : majorant 5 1 2 3 (by decide) 72 = 149

all_declarations.name: Examples.GroupSelectionRecurrence.first_six_recurrence
all_declarations.header: theorem first_six_recurrence : majorant 6 1 2 3 (by decide) 98 = 201

all_declarations.name: Examples.GroupSelectionRecurrence.short_final_group_bound
all_declarations.header:
theorem short_final_group_bound (s : Nat)
    (h : s ≤ (5 / 2) * pivotChild 5 7 + (5 - 5 / 2) * (pivotChild 5 7 / 2)) :
    s ≤ sideChild 5 7

all_declarations.name: Examples.GroupSelectionRecurrence.zero_group_count_bound
all_declarations.header:
theorem zero_group_count_bound (d s : Nat) (hd : 0 < d)
    (h : s ≤ (d / 2) * pivotChild d 0 + (d - d / 2) * (pivotChild d 0 / 2)) :
    s ≤ sideChild d 0

all_declarations.name: Examples.GroupSelectionRecurrence.uniform_resizing
all_declarations.header:
theorem uniform_resizing (d base slope constant : Nat) (hd : 5 ≤ d) :
    ∃ A B : Nat, ∀ m n : Nat, m ≤ n →
      majorant d base slope constant hd m ≤ A * n + B

all_declarations.name: Examples.GroupSelectionRecurrence.positive_base_ne_all_input_linear
all_declarations.header:
theorem positive_base_ne_all_input_linear (d base slope constant : Nat)
    (hd : 5 ≤ d) (hb : 0 < base) :
    ¬ ∃ C : Nat, ∀ n : Nat, majorant d base slope constant hd n ≤ C * n

all_declarations.name: Examples.GroupSelectionRecurrence.exact_book_F_specialization
all_declarations.header:
theorem exact_book_F_specialization :
    ∃ A B : Nat, ∀ n : Nat, Resources.SelectionRecurrence.F n ≤ A * n + B

whole_scope_assessment.fractions: All coefficient definitions cast the natural half-size. Positivity and fraction identity require positive d. contracts_iff_half_gap accounts for Nat subtraction with q<=d, then exact arithmetic yields d>=5; odd r includes0, even r explicitly positive. Zero coefficient example demonstrates why the positivity restriction matters. Sizes3/4 give equality only, not impossibility.
whole_scope_assessment.children: Both children are exact natural ceilings with offsets0 andd. Monotone maps hold even atd0. pivotChild1 n=n is actual first-size self-recursion. two_group_bound_le_child assumes precisely the quantitative bound already proved by the pivot component; its ceil chunk count and explicit d allowance retain short chunks and n0. It is a scalar transport theorem, not a separately assumed desired linear bound.
whole_scope_assessment.recurrence: cutoff_threshold holds by exact ceiling arithmetic; children_lt additionally requiresd>=5. The majorant definition uses that strict decrease before construction and has no desired growth premise. Base/toll are arbitrary Nat including0, with proof hd explicit. Small/large equations, base lower bound and monotonicity are properties of this constructed recurrence. Bounds quantify A B after fixed data but before alln; offsetB covers0 and entireprefix.
whole_scope_assessment.conditional_interface: rounded_group_affine_bound permits signed left/right offsets, fixed natural tolls and startingcutoff, and assumes the exact already-total scalar recurrence. This is a reusable conditional interface. Concrete total majorant and already checked bookF examples witness its intended nonvacuous use. Actual generic measured-run dominance remains a separate obligation.
whole_scope_assessment.asymptotic: majorant_isBigO follows the stronger alln affine bound by absorbingB only above n>=1. Positive-base counterexample retains the failure of an alln pure linear bound at0.
